propositions: Enabling raw Ruff C901 as the repository gate would block every change because 53 over-threshold diagnostics already exist, and per-file or inline ignores would permit new complexity debt.

Introduce a shrink-only complexity baseline where a wrapper script accepts the exact 53 known findings as legacy debt and fails only on new or increased complexity, while allowing reductions and removals reported as stale.

Store ceilings in a canonical sorted JSON file keyed by repo-relative POSIX path plus AST-qualified symbol, with strict schema validation rejecting unknown/missing fields, duplicate keys, unsorted keys, invalid integers, and malformed data.

Define an exit-code contract distinguishing raw Ruff (exit 1), the machine-readable census with --exit-zero (exit 0), and the wrapper verdict which independently exits nonzero on new/increased debt or scanner/schema errors.

Implement a guarded --update-stale maintenance mode that may only lower or remove existing ceilings, refuses to write on new/increased debt or errors, and persists atomically via rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write leaving the target unchanged on failure.
Wire the wrapper --check into make lint over src/rebar while retaining existing Ruff and format checks over both src and tests, and update the maintenance runbook to threshold 15 and scope src/rebar.
